items.title: IQV Q3 deep dive: AI adoption and clinical momentum drive growth, guidance raised
items.summary: Clinical research company IQVIA (NYSE: IQV) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 8% year on year to $4.43 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $17.43 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.34 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
